Messages.Author: ICL
Messages.Body:
Penitent Resilience

[Action Modifier] Action Modifier
[Combat] Combat

[Fortitude] Fortitude & [Obeah] Obeah

[for] [COMBAT] This vampire treats aggravated damage as normal damage. Flash Grenades have no effect on this vampire.
[for] [obe] [COMBAT] As [for] above, but for the remainder of combat.
[FOR] [OBE] [ACTION MODIFIER] Only usable as the action is announced. Choose a vampire. That vampire cannot block this action.

While fairly clear that the double inferior only makes sense if the [for] level lasts one round, I'm surprised that I can't find any errata to this card to clarify its duration. Assuming it has no errata, can it get some?

Traveller Card Game

Messages.Author: ReverendRevolver
Messages.Body: Ive been using this card liberally since it came out, assumed imf for was "this round" and never looked baxk. I forgot it was worded as such.

This one reads :
Combat:
By default, combat cards only apply to the round in which they are played. Explicit card text is needed to overcome this default.  [RTR 19980623]
